# ObjectRef functions, whose ObjectRef and fetched metadata BigQuery documents:
# https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/reference/standard-sql/objectref_functions
#
# tools/e2e serves tests/e2e/gcs/objectref/hello.txt, which holds "hello\n", from fake GCS, and
# connects us.storage of the project test as a Cloud resource connection.

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg').uri
=> "gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg').authorizer
=> null

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg', version => '12345').version
=> "12345"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg', details => JSON '{"gcs_metadata": {"size": 23000}}').details.gcs_metadata.size)
=> "23000"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://mybucket/flowers/12345.jpg', version => 'abc').version
=> "abc"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('not a uri').uri
=> "not a uri"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(CAST(NULL AS STRING)) IS NULL
=> "true"

# OBJ.MAKE_REF qualifies the authorizer with the project of the query.

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/tutorials/cymbal-pets/images/aquaclear-aquarium-background-poster.png', 'us.storage').authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png', 'US.storage').authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png', CONCAT('projects/', @@project_id, '/locations/us/connections/storage')).authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

# Replacing an ObjectRef's authorizer takes one without a project only when the connection exists,
# and does not look up one with a project.

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png'), 'us.storage').authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png'), CONCAT(@@project_id, '.us.storage')).authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png'), CONCAT(@@project_id, '.us.missing')).authorizer
=> "test.us.missing"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png'), CONCAT(@@project_id, '.US.storage')).authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.MAKE_REF(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/x.png'), CONCAT('projects/', @@project_id, '/locations/us/connections/storage')).authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).details.gcs_metadata.md5_hash)
=> "b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).details.gcs_metadata.size)
=> "6"

SELECT OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).authorizer
=> "test.us.storage"

SELECT OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).uri
=> "gs://objectref/hello.txt"

# The version is the object's generation, and the update time is in whole seconds.

SELECT REGEXP_CONTAINS(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).version, r'^[0-9]+$')
=> "true"

SELECT MOD(INT64(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).details.gcs_metadata.updated), 1000000)
=> "0"

# Direct access, without an authorizer.

SELECT JSON_VALUE(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt')).details.gcs_metadata.size)
=> "6"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA([OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage'), OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')]))
=> "2"

SELECT OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<uri STRING, version STRING, authorizer STRING, details JSON>)) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 'us.storage')))
=> "null"

# A failure is recorded in the details instead of failing the query, keeping the version and
# making a NULL one empty.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/tutorials/cymbal-pets/images/aquaclear-aquarium-background-poster.png', 'us.missing')))
=> "{\"uri\":\"gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/tutorials/cymbal-pets/images/aquaclear-aquarium-background-poster.png\",\"version\":\"\",\"authorizer\":\"test.us.missing\",\"details\":{\"errors\":[{\"code\":400,\"message\":\"Connection credential for test.us.missing cannot be used. Either the connection does not exist, or the user does not have sufficient permissions (bigquery.objectRefs.read)\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/tutorials/cymbal-pets/images/aquaclear-aquarium-background-poster.png', 'us.missing', version => 'abc')).version)
=> "\"abc\""

# The connection is checked before the URI, and a failure replaces the details.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('not a uri', 'us.missing')))
=> "{\"uri\":\"not a uri\",\"version\":\"\",\"authorizer\":\"test.us.missing\",\"details\":{\"errors\":[{\"code\":400,\"message\":\"Connection credential for test.us.missing cannot be used. Either the connection does not exist, or the user does not have sufficient permissions (bigquery.objectRefs.read)\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://cloud-samples-data/bigquery/tutorials/cymbal-pets/images/aquaclear-aquarium-background-poster.png', 'us.missing', details => JSON '{"gcs_metadata": {"size": 1}}')).details)
=> "{\"errors\":[{\"code\":400,\"message\":\"Connection credential for test.us.missing cannot be used. Either the connection does not exist, or the user does not have sufficient permissions (bigquery.objectRefs.read)\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}"

# The URI is checked after the connection, and the version is parsed but the current version is
# read.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/does-not-exist.txt', 'us.storage')))
=> "{\"uri\":\"gs://objectref/does-not-exist.txt\",\"version\":\"\",\"authorizer\":\"test.us.storage\",\"details\":{\"errors\":[{\"code\":404,\"message\":\"No such object\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('not a uri', 'us.storage')))
=> "{\"uri\":\"not a uri\",\"version\":\"\",\"authorizer\":\"test.us.storage\",\"details\":{\"errors\":[{\"code\":400,\"message\":\"URI not a uri is not in the expected format. Supported format is gs://bucket/path/to/object\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage', version => 'abc')))
=> "{\"uri\":\"gs://objectref/hello.txt\",\"version\":\"abc\",\"authorizer\":\"test.us.storage\",\"details\":{\"errors\":[{\"code\":400,\"message\":\"Failed to parse object version number: abc\",\"source\":\"OBJ.FETCH_METADATA\"}]}}"

SELECT OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage', version => '1')).version = OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage')).version
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage', version => '1')).details.gcs_metadata.size)
=> "6"

# Fetched metadata replaces the details.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(OBJ.FETCH_METADATA(OBJ.MAKE_REF('gs://objectref/hello.txt', 'us.storage', details => JSON '{"gcs_metadata": {"size": 1}}')).details.gcs_metadata.size)
=> "6"
